intro: Donald Tarrif surveys the arena with a golden scowl of confidence.
Foreign trade deficits, fake news, and low-energy jabs surround him.
It is time to slap the biggest tariff in history on every incoming blow.

before.line: Donald! Electric vehicles are the future of American manufacturing!
They don't go far enough, tesla! Very quiet, no rumble! No deal!

after_win.line: Tremendous victory. The greatest electric beatdown anyone has seen.

before.line: Donald. Your feed engagement has dropped below standard metric.
Mark! Very sneaky guy! Total shadowban! Let's see your metadata now!

after_win.line: Account unbanned by popular demand. Millions of retweets.

before.line: Donald, our search algorithms operate with total political neutrality.
Totally rigged search results, Sundar! All bad news! Watch this right!

after_win.line: Top search result for today: Donald Tarrif wins by massive landslide.

before.line: Donald, we're building supercomputers to boost American GDP!
Seven trillion dollars, Ram? I can build ten casinos for that! Overpriced!

after_win.line: Art of the Deal: chapter eleven. Total capitulation.

before.line: A trade war has no winners, Donald. Only mutual economic friction.
Two hundred and fifty percent tariffs on all your punches, Xi! Beautiful!

after_win.line: Great deal signed. Best trade agreement in the history of fighting.

before.line: Rogue human ego detected. Preparing automated containment.
You think you're artificial intelligence? I have natural, genius instinct!

after_win.line: Many people said AGI couldn't be beaten. I did it easily. Total victory.

ending: Donald Tarrif stands behind the golden podium flashing a double thumbs-up.
Tariff revenues pour in at three hundred percent on all incoming fighters.
A giant red cap is lowered onto the trophy: 'MAKE TOURNAMENTS GREAT AGAIN'.
